set_dispatch.text: Save up to 15 named DF stations. Enter MHz with three decimals (for example 225.025) and coordinates as latitude,longitude.
SAVE validates and persists the draft. SET DF tunes the radio and creates the DF bearing. Built-in object frequencies are reserved.
Each object station is OFF until enabled. SET DF is available only while the named object exists on scene.
Custom station records and ON/OFF object choices are saved in the DF Stations table.
